name: UGCA 320 (Hubble)
blurb: UGCA 320, a gas-rich dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugca320-hubble
story: A small, gas-rich galaxy lit by ionized gas from recent star formation, its disk most likely stirred by a recent tidal encounter with its close neighbor UGCA 319.

claims.text: UGCA 320 is a gas-rich dwarf irregular galaxy in a nearby, relatively isolated group of dwarf galaxies
It has abundant ionized gas powered mostly by recent star formation
Its disturbances point to a recent tidal interaction, most likely with its close neighbor UGCA 319
UGCA 320 is PGC 45084, a target of program 14636 at RA 13 03 16.7, Dec -17 25 23
